nodes.label: Browser (user)
nodes.description: The Ask web UI. Public users reach prod through Cloudflare; LAN users can also open staging (:3739) and lab (:3742) directly.

nodes.label: Operator (LAN / SSH)
nodes.description: The engineer on the LAN: SSH to fleet hosts, Model Manager via an SSH tunnel to 127.0.0.1:3939, direct lab/staging access.

nodes.label: Cloudflare edge
nodes.description: Public ingress for ask.hbqnexus.win. The tunnel connection is outbound from .17; there is no router port-forward. Ingress rules live in the Cloudflare dashboard.

nodes.label: NightFuryX · .17
nodes.description: Threadripper 3970X, 117 GB, Windows + WSL2 with Docker Desktop. GPUs: RTX 2080 Ti 22 GB (reranker + Whisper), Quadro P2200 (Kokoro TTS), GTX 1070 (qwen3-vl VLM). Runs every Ask app stack.

nodes.label: NightFuryS · .160
nodes.description: i7-12700, 58 GB, WSL2 + Docker Desktop, Quadro P4000 8 GB. Hosts the GPU embedder.

nodes.label: Serenity · .171
nodes.description: Xeon E5-2670 v3, 94 GB, WSL2, Quadro P5000 16 GB. Hosts the local small LLM (granite4.2:8b) on native Ollama.

nodes.label: MiniNightFury · .231
nodes.description: i7-12650H, 31 GB, native Linux, no GPU. Hosts crawl4ai (fast single-thread crawling), the public SearXNG/degoog, the staging/lab classifier Ollama and the idle legacy Ask stacks.

nodes.label: cloudflared (Windows svc)
nodes.description: Windows service (auto-start) on the .17 Windows host; token tunnel mapping ask.hbqnexus.win → localhost:3738 (prod only).

nodes.label: Ask prod
nodes.description: Next.js app, container ask, compose project ask-stack, branch dev (ask-prod worktree). Supabase auth. The only internet-exposed service.

nodes.label: Ask staging
nodes.description: Next.js app, container ask-admin-feature, project ask-stack-admin-feature, branch admin-feature (ask worktree). Supabase auth, LAN-only.

nodes.label: Ask lab
nodes.description: Next.js app, container ask-lab, project ask-stack-lab, branch flow-design (ask-flow worktree). ENABLE_AUTH=false: everyone is user lab-harness. Experiments run here first.

nodes.label: Postgres ×3 (pgvector)
nodes.description: Per-env pgvector/pgvector:pg17, no host port. Chats/messages/parts, files, memories, recall chunks. RLS enforced through the app_user role; migrations run fail-hard at app boot.

nodes.label: Redis ×3
nodes.description: Per-env redis:alpine, noeviction, no host port. Search caches, resumable-stream pointers + pub/sub, latency:log, metered-API budgets, ingest heartbeat, imagegen counters.

nodes.label: SearXNG + gluetun ×3
nodes.description: Per-env SearXNG inside a gluetun Mullvad WireGuard namespace (kill-switch). Quality mode only. UI on 3741/3740/3743 (unauthenticated). The configured fallback does not resolve on .17.

nodes.label: Ollama (.17)
nodes.description: Native systemd, unauthenticated on 0.0.0.0. Proxies *:cloud models (answering model, prod classifier) to Ollama Cloud; serves qwen3-vl:4b on the GTX 1070 to the ingestors.

nodes.label: Reranker (Qwen3-8B)
nodes.description: reranker-qwen: Qwen3-Reranker-8B on the 2080 Ti, POST /rerank, bearer token (timing-safe, fails closed). Search degrades to bi-encoder then keyword when it is down.

nodes.label: Whisper STT
nodes.description: ask-whisper (speaches, faster-distil-whisper-large-v3) on the 2080 Ti for dictation. Unauthenticated. Down → /api/voice/transcribe returns 503.

nodes.label: Kokoro TTS
nodes.description: ask-tts (:8890, prod+staging) and ask-tts-lab (:3744) on the Quadro P2200 for read-aloud. Unauthenticated. Down → /api/voice/speak returns 503.

nodes.label: Ingestor workers ×3
nodes.description: ingestor / ingestor-staging / ingestor-lab (separate repo dir). Pull upload jobs from /api/ingest/* with INGEST_API_TOKEN; images via qwen3-vl on the .17 Ollama, audio via in-process CPU whisper.

nodes.label: Model Manager
nodes.description: Root-equivalent config UI on 127.0.0.1:3939 (docker.sock + prod worktree RW + SSH key). Edits prod .env with backups and recreates prod; edits/restarts the reranker over SSH.

nodes.label: degoog ×3 (stopped)
nodes.description: Per-env degoog stacks (:4445/:4446/:4447) moved to .17 on 2026-09-07; stopped, and DEGOOG_ENABLED=false in every env.

nodes.label: GPU embedder
nodes.description: Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B (1024-d) + MiniLM, POST /embed, bearer token. Used by memory, recall and upload RAG. Data-locked to the vector(1024) columns.

nodes.label: Ollama granite4.2:8b
nodes.description: Native Ollama on the P5000 (LOCAL_LLM_BASE_URL): titles, memory extraction, query-expansion fallback, voice gist. Unauthenticated.

nodes.label: crawl4ai
nodes.description: unclecode/crawl4ai:0.9.2 headless-browser crawler, bearer token, 8 GiB cap with a */15 memory watchdog. Down → capped in-process JSDOM crawl.

nodes.label: Ollama (.231)
nodes.description: Native Ollama used as the cloud proxy for the staging and lab classifier (CLASSIFIER_OLLAMA_BASE_URL hardcoded in their overlays).

nodes.label: FlareSolverr
nodes.description: Loopback-bound (127.0.0.1:8191) on .231; the app's FLARESOLVERR_URL does not resolve on .17, so this fetch rescue tier is currently always skipped.

nodes.label: Public SearXNG
nodes.description: search.hbqnexus.win (:8127 via searxng-gluetun): the owner's personal instance. Ask must never point at it.

nodes.label: Public degoog
nodes.description: degoog behind degoog-gluetun on :4444. Public/personal with human consumers — never decommission.

nodes.label: Legacy Ask volumes (containers removed)
nodes.description: Pre-migration prod/staging/lab Ask stacks. Containers and networks removed 2026-09-23; only their data volumes remain, pending a decision to delete.

nodes.label: Ollama Cloud
nodes.description: Hosted *:cloud models (default answering model kimi-k2.6:cloud, classifier deepseek-v4-pro:cloud) reached via signed-in local daemons, plus ollama.com web search (OLLAMA_SEARCH_API_KEY). 402 = extra-usage balance empty.

nodes.label: Search APIs
nodes.description: Metered, Redis-budgeted (fail closed): Tavily, Brave, LangSearch. Fired in balanced and quality modes.

nodes.label: Fetch rescue APIs
nodes.description: Jina Reader, Tavily Extract, Firecrawl: later tiers of the fetch tool's rescue chain.

nodes.label: Mullvad → engines
nodes.description: WireGuard exit used only by SearXNG to reach Google CSE, Bing, DuckDuckGo etc. from a non-residential IP; rotated daily.

nodes.label: Supabase Auth
nodes.description: Hosted auth for prod and staging; sessions verified server-side with auth.getUser(). Lab doesn't use it.

nodes.label: Replicate
nodes.description: Image generation and editing (generateImage tool, authenticated users only).

nodes.label: Open-Meteo / OSM / ipapi
nodes.description: Weather forecast + geocoding, Nominatim location search, IP geolocation fallback for the weather widget.
